map.DIC 弥散性血管内凝血 ISTH 评分器: DIC disseminated intravascular coagulation ISTH score
map.→ 打开外周血干细胞 CD34+ 计数器工具: -> Open the peripheral blood stem cell CD34+ counter tool
map.判断能否满足单次/双次自体移植的剂量要求（≥2 / ≥5×10⁶/kg）: Check whether the dose requirement for single or double autologous transplant is met (>=2 / >=5×10⁶/kg)
map.剂量 ≥2×10⁶/kg 是怎么来的？: Where does the >=2×10⁶/kg dose come from?
map.动员后评估采集时机：看外周血 CD34+ 绝对值是否达采集门槛: After mobilisation, assess collection timing by whether the peripheral blood CD34+ absolute count reaches the collection threshold
map.外周血 CD34+ 绝对值越高，单次采集越易达到移植剂量；临床常以 ≥10–20: The higher the peripheral blood CD34+ absolute count, the easier a single collection reaches the transplant dose; clinically >=10-20/μL is the best collection window, while below 5/μL yields are low and more cycles are needed.
map.外周血干细胞 CD34+ 计数器 使用指南: Peripheral blood stem cell CD34+ counter user guide
map.按采集物 CD34%、WBC、体积、体重估算回输剂量（×10⁶/kg）: Estimate the reinfusion dose (×10⁶/kg) from CD34%, WBC, volume and weight of the collected product
map.自体造血干细胞移植经验阈值：≥2×10⁶/kg 多可稳定植入，≥5×10⁶/kg: Autologous haematopoietic stem cell transplant empirical thresholds: >=2×10⁶/kg usually engrafts stably and >=5×10⁶/kg allows considering a double transplant or faster haematopoietic recovery; below that, additional collection is needed. The transplant protocol and centre standards govern.
map.输入外周血及采集物中的 CD34+ 阳性率、白细胞计数等数据，计算 CD34+: Enter the CD34+ positive rate, white blood cell count and other data from peripheral blood and the collected product to compute the CD34+ cell dose (cells/kg) and assess whether the stem cell collection meets the transplant threshold.
map.：CD34+/μL = CD34% × WBC(×10⁹/L) × 10 / 1: : CD34+/μL = CD34% × WBC(×10⁹/L) × 10 / 100; collected CD34+ total (cells) = CD34+/μL × volume(mL) × 1000; expected yield = total × collection efficiency; dose(×10⁶/kg) = yield / body weight / 10⁶. Timing: CD34+/μL >=10 ideal, >=5 adequate, >=2 low, <2 continue mobilisation.
map.：例（外周血 CD34%=0.8、WBC=25×10⁹/L、处理血量=12000: : example (peripheral blood CD34%=0.8, WBC=25×10⁹/L, processed volume=12000 mL, collection efficiency=40%, weight=70 kg): CD34+/μL=0.8×25×10/100=2.0/μL; total=2.0×12000×1000=2.4×10⁷; yield=2.4×10⁷×0.4=9.6×10⁶; dose=9.6×10⁶/70/10⁶=0.14×10⁶/kg (low, so add collection cycles or strengthen mobilisation).
